三条新信息
班长在失误后鼓励了小组成员。老师仔细听取了两名学生的话。俱乐部把头盔借给成员。
词语提示：monitor 班长；error 失误；pupil 学生；helmet 头盔。

options.text: The monitor encouraged the group after the error. The teacher listened to both pupils carefully. The club lends helmets to its members.
The monitor encouraged the group before the error. The teacher listened to both pupils carefully. The club lends helmets to its members.
The monitor encouraged the group after the error. The teacher listened to only one pupil carefully. The club lends helmets to its members.
The monitor encouraged the group after the error. The teacher listened to both pupils carefully. The club gives helmets away to its members.

answer.display: The monitor encouraged the group after the error. The teacher listened to both pupils carefully. The club lends helmets to its members.

explanation.strategy: 核对鼓励的先后、听取两名学生的话及认真程度，再核对借出的方向和关系。
